issues.problem: obhe is not a typo: it is the Vedic sandhi ā + ubhe (ā belongs to paprāḥ: 'ā prāḥ' = filled up). The Ṛgvedic parallel RV 6.19.6 itself reads 'ródasī obhé suśipra prāḥ', so the flag invents a variant and the claim 'the RV parallel reads ubhe' is false.
issues.fix: remove the obhe flag; keep only the pupuri flag

value.why: possible: the Ṛgvedic parallel (RV 6.19.6) reads papuri 'abundant'; pupuri is not a known form

issues.problem: token obhe must be split as ā + ubhe (ā + u > o); the preverb ā goes with paprāḥ.
note should record the obhe = ā ubhe analysis instead of the false claim about the RV reading.

patch.value: Ṛgvedic mantra (RV 6.19.6, which reads papuri and, in its second half, yeneme citra vajrahasta rodasī obhe suśipra prāḥ). obhe = ā + ubhe (Vedic sandhi), the ā belonging to paprāḥ ('filled up'). didhṛkṣema taken as desiderative optative of √dhṛ; yat as the relative pronoun referring to śravaḥ.

issues.problem: A root-noun stem in -ṣāh cannot have a vocative singular in -ṣāhaḥ (voc. would be -ṣāṭ). abhimātiṣāhaḥ is gen. sg., agreeing with te: 'your (the conqueror of assailants') milky juices, strengths, manly powers'. The English and Hindi vocatives follow the wrong label.
issues.fix: gloss 'of the conqueror of assailants', gram 'm. gen. sg. tat-puruṣa (with te)'; translations adjusted

summary: 55 units checked word by word against the Sanskrit. 3 error-level issues in 2 units: 586 (obhe wrongly flagged as a typo and split as ubhe; it is Vedic ā + ubhe, exactly as RV 6.19.6 reads, so the flag invents a variant) and 603 (abhimātiṣāhaḥ labelled vocative; the form can only be genitive, so gloss, gram, English and Hindi change). 19 minor issues: glossary consistency (vajrin, maghavan, svar in 588/597/601/612/630/636), small additions in the Hindi not present in the Sanskrit (587 चराचर, 592 सोम, 602 उसने...किया है, 621 सब ओर, 622 पाप, 628 सूर्य), two grammar labels (596 mimeti is not intensive; 606 manvata is injunctive) and one split (626 udeta = ut ā ita). One item left for a human: 588 supplies ऐश्वर्य in the Hindi (low-confidence unit). No regrouping suggested: the single-line 591 and the three-line 611 follow the edition's numbering and the draft's GROUPING notes are sensible; 614's single-pāda second line is explained correctly. Low confidence on 588, 606, 611 is honest and should stay. Glossary additions suggested: vajrī (nom.) = the wielder of the thunderbolt (वज्रधारी); puruṣa (RV 10.90) = the Puruṣa (पुरुष); dyāvāpṛthivī = Heaven and Earth (द्यावा-पृथिवी); apāṃ napāt = the Son of the Waters (अपां नपात्); jātavedas = Jātavedas (जातवेदा); vaiśvānara = Vaiśvānara (वैश्वानर); prajāpati = Prajāpati (प्रजापति); varuṇa = Varuṇa (वरुण); mitra = Mitra (मित्र); aditi = Aditi (अदिति); sūrya = Sūrya / the sun (सूर्य); rodasī = the two worlds (दोनों लोक); vāja = prize/strength, Hindi वाज; aṃhas = distress (संकट); yaśas = glory (यश); varcas = lustre (तेज); pluta figure 3 inside a token = a separate word {"w":"3"} glossed 'pluta (prolongation) mark; chant syllable (stobha)', never translated.
